title: Cortical lamina technique: A therapeutic approach for lateral ridge augmentation using guided bone regeneration
authors: Deepika-Penmetsa SL, Thomas R, Baron TK, Shah R, Mehta DS5. J Clin Exp Dent. 2017; 9(1):e21-e26.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The present study demonstrates that bone lamina technique can be effective means of horizontal ridge augmentation and the use of mineralized allograft in combination with xenograft and collagen membrane leads to good amount of bone regeneration for subsequent implant placement” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
